question.text: Which of the following is NOT a permitted source of funding for a buyback of shares?

answer.text: Proceeds of any earlier issue of other kinds of shares or securities
Proceeds from issuance of the same kind of shares being bought back

explanation.text: The Logic: A buyback can be funded from (a) free reserves, (b) securities premium account, or (c) proceeds of issue of shares/securities — but NOT from proceeds of the same kind of shares/securities being bought back. This prevents circular transactions. The Trap: "Proceeds of any earlier issue of other kinds of shares or securities" is actually permitted, and candidates may confuse it with the prohibited source involving the same kind of shares.
